newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.

text.p: Indonesia tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices were stable in late trading with some inquiries reported, traders said.
They said a deal was done this afternoon at 47.75 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan for August shipment. Buyers bid at 47.00 in Medan but sellers did not want to sell at that level.

"The market is quite stable and we do not see much movement in prices. Buyers are looking for cheaper prices, but sellers expect prices to improve further because of the tight supply," said one trader.
Traders said offer prices were quoted at 48.00 fob Medan and Surabaya, 47.625 fob Padang, and 47.25 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
